## Checklist

- [ ] The change is game-agnostic, or the title-specific part sits in `dm/games/<id>/`.
- [ ] No game files, keys, firmware or derived data, and no `data/` content.
- [ ] Tests added or updated; the CI suites in CONTRIBUTING.md pass locally, and so do the local-only suites I touched.
- [ ] No internal identifier, file or directory renamed (`dm/`, `dmhost`, `dmsh_*`).
- [ ] Docs updated when behaviour or options change.
- [ ] Screenshots or a short video attached for any visible change.
- [ ] Commit messages follow conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, ...).
